how.title: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Three things you do.
how.lede: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] There is no setup, no dashboard to learn and no plan to choose. From the box above to a shop that can receive a payment is five screens, and you can stop reading this page and just do it.
how.calloutStrong: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Nothing is charged, ever, until you make a sale.
how.callout: [NEEDS TRANSLATION]  No trial that quietly starts billing, no card held on file, no plan to cancel.

one.title: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Photograph it, or type one line
one.body: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Whichever is faster. SolAI reads the photo, works out the category, and never asks you to pick from a list of forty.

two.title: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] SolAI builds the shop
two.body: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Five product shots, a written listing in Kinyarwanda and English, and a price checked against what similar things actually sell for in your city. Change anything you don't like.

three.title: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Give us your number
three.body: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] That's your account and your payout wallet at once. No email, no password, no card. Then your link is live and you can share it.

protection.eyebrow: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Why a stranger will buy from you
protection.title: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Their money sits with us until you've delivered.
protection.lede: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] The reason most small sellers stay stuck selling to people they already know is simple: a stranger has no reason to believe a parcel is coming. So we take that decision away from both of you.

paid.title: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] The buyer pays SolAI, not you
paid.body: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] A normal MoMo prompt appears on their phone. It says "Amara Beads via SolAI", so nobody is paying an anonymous merchant code and wondering where the money went.

held.title: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] We hold it — really hold it
held.body: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] The money sits in our collection account, tracked against the order in a double-entry ledger. It is not yours yet and it is no longer theirs. Both of you can see exactly where it is.

code.title: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] A four-digit code releases it
code.body: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] The buyer gets the code by SMS. They read it out to the courier at the door. Nobody is taking anybody's word for anything — the code is the proof, and it only exists on the buyer's phone.

released.title: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] You're paid in seconds
released.body: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Straight to your wallet — typically under ten seconds, not the two to seven days a card platform would take. If the buyer never confirms, it releases to you automatically after 72 hours.

dispute.title: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Didn't arrive?
dispute.body: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] The buyer is refunded. Disputes are answered by a person within 48 hours — that promise is on the product page, not buried in terms.

cash.title: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Paying cash?
cash.body: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Cash on delivery goes through the same escrow. The courier collects it into the hold — never straight into a pocket.

mock.hint: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Tap any step to move the money
mock.heldNote: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] In SolAI's account — not yours, not theirs — until the code is entered.
mock.codeIntro: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] The buyer reads this to the courier
mock.codeNote: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Only their phone has it. Not you, not the courier, not us.
mock.releasedNote: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] MTN · landed in 4 seconds · fees itemised on the order

whatsapp.title: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Your shop lives
whatsapp.lede: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Not a link you paste and hope someone opens. A real catalogue people scroll in the chat, with checkout in the same conversation. When you're busy, SolAI answers — with the price, the stock and the delivery time, in whichever language they wrote to you in.

protection.body: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Orders from a chat are held in escrow exactly like orders from your link.

builtFor.title: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Designed around the phone in your hand, not the one in a demo.

momo.title: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Mobile money first
momo.body: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] MTN and Airtel are the default — for buyers paying and for you getting paid. Card exists for the few who want it. No bank account anywhere.

currency.title: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Prices in your currency
currency.body: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] RWF, UGX, KES, TZS. Never a dollar figure you have to convert in your head before you know whether you can afford it.

language.title: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] In your language
language.body: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Kinyarwanda, Swahili, French and English throughout — including the listing SolAI writes and the replies it sends your customers.

signal.title: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Works on 3G
signal.body: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Tested with data saver on, on an Android under $150. Every screen is built to open on a bad connection, because that's the connection.

pricing.title: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] You pay us after you've been paid.
pricing.lede: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Nobody in this market should be putting card details into a platform that hasn't earned them anything yet. So there's no card at signup, no trial, and no plan decision until after your first payout — and when we do show you a paid plan, we'll tell you if you'd be better off staying free.

chips.noFee: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] No monthly fee on Free

lines.cut: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Our cut, only when you sell

pricing.footnote: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] On an RWF 8,500 bracelet that's RWF 255. The mobile-money disbursement fee is shown separately on every order, so you always see the real number before you agree to it.

buyers.eyebrow: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] If you're buying, not selling
buyers.title: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] You're never sending money to a stranger.
buyers.body: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] You're paying SolAI. We hold it, you get a delivery code that only you have, and the seller is paid the moment you hand that code over. If nothing arrives, you're refunded — and a person answers you inside 48 hours.

bullets.record: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Every seller has a visible record — orders delivered, orders confirmed, how fast they ship.
bullets.hold: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] New sellers are held longer until that record exists. That's the point of it.
bullets.track: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Tracked to your door by the courier network, with the code as the handover.

sellers.title: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] People who were already selling — just to fewer people.

amara.text: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] "I was selling to my cousins and their friends. The first time somebody I had never met paid me, I checked my phone four times. Now that happens most days."

grace.text: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] "The photos it makes are better than mine. That was the part I was putting off every evening, and it does it while I'm still holding the phone."

faq.title: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] The ones people actually ask.
faq.lede: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] If yours isn't here, message us on WhatsApp — a person replies, usually within the hour.

bank.question: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Do I need a bank account?
bank.answer: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] No. Your mobile money wallet is the payout account, and for most sellers it's the same number they signed up with. If you'd rather use a bank account you can add one, but it settles in one to three days instead of seconds, so almost nobody does.

when.question: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] When exactly do I get the money?
when.answer: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] The moment the delivery code is entered at handover — typically under ten seconds later. If the buyer never confirms and never raises a problem, it releases to you automatically 72 hours after delivery. You can see which of those two clocks is running on the order at any time.

lie.question: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] What if the buyer lies and says it never arrived?
lie.answer: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] The courier records GPS and a photo at handover, and the code can only come from the buyer's own phone. A dispute is decided on that evidence, not on who complains loudest, and buyers who make repeated false claims are limited the same way fraudulent sellers are.

edit.question: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Can I change what SolAI writes about my product?
edit.answer: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] All of it — the name, the price, the description, which photos to keep. It's a draft, not a decision. Most sellers change the price and leave the rest.

free.question: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Is it really free?
free.answer: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Yes, and it stays free. We take 3% when you make a sale and nothing when you don't. There is no card at signup and no trial that starts charging. A paid plan exists for sellers doing high volume, and we only mention it once you'd actually save money on it.

holding.question: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Who is holding my customers' money?
holding.answer: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] SolAI, in a mobile money merchant account kept separate from the money the business runs on. Every held amount is tracked against a specific order in a double-entry ledger, reconciled against the account twice a day. Your funds are never used for anything else, and support staff can decide the outcome of a case but can never send money to an account that isn't already on the order.

storefront.aiNoteTitle: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] This one is a styled picture
storefront.aiNoteBody: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] SolAI placed the seller's real item into a setting. Photo 1 is always the actual item, taken by the seller.
storefront.trustTitle: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] {name} does not get your money yet
storefront.trustBody: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] You pay SolAI. We hold it, and release it only when you have the bracelet in your hands. If it never arrives, you are refunded.
storefront.confirmedReceived: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Confirmed received by the buyer
storefront.newerSellerNote: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] A newer seller. SolAI holds their money longer until that record grows — which is exactly what makes a first order safe for you.
storefront.recentNote: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] These are deliveries the buyer confirmed with their own code. They are not written reviews and nobody can post one without having bought.
storefront.shopEscrowNote: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Whatever you buy here, your money is held by SolAI until it reaches you. Disputes are answered by a person within 48 hours.
storefront.notifyTitle: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Tell me when it is back
storefront.notifyHint: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] One message when it is available. Nothing else, ever.
storefront.notifyOk: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] We will message you the moment it is back
storefront.notifyShort: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] That number looks too short
storefront.askWhenBack: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Ask {name} when it is back
storefront.goneTitle: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] This listing is not available
storefront.goneLede: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] It was taken down, or the seller removed it. Nothing has been charged to you and no order was created.
storefront.goneNote: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] If you already paid for something from this shop, that order is unaffected and still protected. Open the link in your SMS to see it.
storefront.goneCta: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] See the rest of the shop
storefront.protTitle: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] How your money is protected
storefront.protStep1: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] You pay SolAI, not {name}. The MoMo prompt says "{name} via SolAI" so you know where it went.
storefront.protStep2: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] We hold the money. It is not hers and it is no longer yours. Both of you can see where it is.
storefront.protStep3: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] You get a four-digit code by SMS. You give it at the door, once the parcel is in your hands.
storefront.protStep4: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] That code is what pays {name}. Nothing else does.
storefront.protWarn: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Never give the code before you have the item. Anyone asking for it early — including someone claiming to be from SolAI — is trying to take your money.
storefront.protSla: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Nothing arrives? Report it and you are refunded. A person answers within 48 hours.

faq.accountQ: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Do I need an account?
faq.accountA: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] No. You need a phone number so we can send you the delivery code and tell you where your order is.
faq.payA: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Now, into SolAI's account. Or choose cash on delivery and pay the courier — that goes into the same hold, not straight into the seller's pocket.
faq.wrongQ: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] What if it is the wrong thing?
faq.wrongA: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Report it from your order page. The money is still held while we look, and it is refunded if the seller cannot resolve it.
faq.collectQ: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Can I collect it myself?
faq.collectA: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Yes — choose that at delivery and there is no fee. You still get a code, and you still give it only when you have the item.
faq.photosA: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Photo 1 is always the seller's own photo of the actual item. Anything marked Styled is that item placed into a generated setting.

storefront.reportLede: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] A person reviews every report. The seller is not told who reported them.
storefront.reportOk: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Reported. A person will look at this listing.

reportReasons.stolenPhotos: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] The pictures are not theirs

checkout.title: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Checkout
checkout.secure: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Paying SolAI, not the seller
checkout.headline: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Almost yours
checkout.lede: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] No account needed. We only need a number, so we can send you the delivery code and tell you where your order is.
checkout.name: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Your name
checkout.phoneHint: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] The delivery code comes here by SMS. This is also how the courier reaches you.
checkout.landmark: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] How the courier finds you
checkout.landmarkPh: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Near the market, blue gate opposite the pharmacy
checkout.landmarkHint: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] A landmark works better than an address here. This is only shown to the courier.
checkout.pickupNote: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] {name} will message you the exact place and time once you have paid. You still get a code, and you still give it only when the item is in your hands.
checkout.mtnSub: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] A prompt comes to your phone. Nothing to type in here.
checkout.sameNum: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Pay from the same number
checkout.codSub: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Pay the courier. Still protected the same way.
checkout.codBody: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] The courier collects the cash and it goes into the same hold. The seller is paid after you give the code — never before.
checkout.codHint: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Have the exact amount if you can. Couriers rarely carry change.
checkout.cardSub: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Visa or Mastercard. Slower to clear.
checkout.cardNote: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Card payments take 2–7 days to clear before the seller can be paid. Mobile money is instant, which is why it is first.
checkout.paySolaiNote: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] You are paying SolAI, not {name}. We release her money only once you confirm the item reached you.
checkout.terms: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] By paying you agree to the buyer terms. We keep your number to run this order and to tell you about it — nothing else.
checkout.feeNote: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] SolAI charges the seller, not you. The price you see is the price you pay.
checkout.heldTitle: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Held until it reaches you
checkout.heldBody: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Not delivered? Refunded. A person answers a problem within 48 hours.
checkout.afterTitle: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] What happens after you pay
checkout.after1: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] 1 · You get a four-digit code by SMS.
checkout.after2: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] 2 · {name} packs it and a courier collects.
checkout.after3: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] 3 · You give the code at the door — only then is she paid.
checkout.errName: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] The courier needs a name to ask for.
checkout.errPhone: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] That number looks too short — we send your code here.
checkout.errGeneric: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Something went wrong. Nothing was charged.
checkout.promptLede: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] A payment request has been sent to {phone}. Approve it with your MoMo PIN.
checkout.simNote: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] The seller's name is in the prompt on purpose. You should never be paying a merchant code you do not recognise.
checkout.waiting: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Waiting for you to approve
checkout.dontClose: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Do not close this page. It updates on its own.
checkout.resent: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Request sent again — check your phone
checkout.cancelChange: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Cancel and change how I pay
checkout.promptHelp: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] No prompt after a minute? Dial your MoMo menu and check pending approvals, or send the request again. Nothing is charged until you enter your PIN.
checkout.failTitle: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] That payment did not go through
checkout.failLede: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Nothing has been taken from your wallet, and your order has not been placed. Nobody is holding your money.
checkout.fail1: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] The PIN was wrong, or the request timed out.
checkout.fail2: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Not enough in the wallet — the total is {total}.
checkout.fail3: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] The network was busy. This one fixes itself; just try again.
checkout.waHelpText: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Hello SolAI, my payment for {product} from {shop} failed.
checkout.failBasket: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Your basket is still here. The item is not reserved though — if someone else buys the last one first, we will tell you and refund anything taken.
checkout.codTitle: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Paying cash at the door
checkout.codLede: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Nothing is charged now. Here is exactly how it will go.
checkout.codStep1: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] {name} packs it and a courier brings it to you.
checkout.codStep2: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] You pay the courier {total} and check the item.
checkout.codStep3: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] The cash goes into SolAI's hold — not into the seller's pocket.
checkout.codStep4: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] You give your code, and only then is she paid.
checkout.codExact: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Bring the exact amount if you can — couriers rarely carry change. If the item is not what was described, do not pay and do not give the code.
checkout.paidLede: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Your code is on its way by SMS. Taking you to your order.
checkout.sessionMissingLede: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] That checkout session is gone. Go back to the product and tap Buy now again.

protected.suspendedBanner: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] This seller’s shop is paused. Your order and held money are unaffected — we still protect this delivery the same way.
protected.heldLede: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] {name} can see your order. She cannot see your money — and she will not be paid until you say it reached you.
protected.codeBody: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Give it to the courier only once the item is in your hands. That is the moment {name} gets paid.
protected.codeWarn: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Nobody should ask you for this code before delivery. Not the seller, not the courier, not anyone saying they are from SolAI. If someone does, report it and do not give it.
protected.moneyWhereBody: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] In SolAI’s account, against this order. Not {name}’s, and no longer yours. It moves one way or the other — to her when you confirm, or back to you if it never arrives.
protected.cancelNote: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] You can cancel free until the courier collects it. After that, report a problem instead.
protected.transitTitle: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] It is with the courier
protected.transitLede: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Have your code ready. Check the item first, then read the code out.
protected.readOut: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Read this out at the door
protected.readOutBody: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Only after you have the item and it is what you ordered.
protected.callCourierToast: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Calling the courier — your number stays hidden from him
protected.transitNote: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] If the item is not what was described, do not give the code. Report it instead and the money stays held while a person looks.
protected.alreadyHaveBody: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Confirm receipt to release payment. We ask for the last 4 digits of the phone you used at checkout.
protected.nobodyConfirmsBody: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] If you never confirm and never report a problem, we release to {name} after the delivery window — usually a few days. Report early if something is wrong.
protected.doneLede: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Your money was released to {name}. Thanks for shopping protected.
protected.howWasItLede: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] A quick note helps the next buyer.
protected.rateGood: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Thank you — that helps the next buyer
protected.rateOther: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Noted — thanks for telling us
protected.shareFailed: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Could not share — copy the link from your browser
protected.disputeTitle: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] We are looking into it
protected.disputeLede: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Your {total} stays held. {name} is not paid while a person reviews this.
protected.dispute1: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] A SolAI person reads what you reported.
protected.dispute2: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] We may message you or {name} on WhatsApp for photos or a short call.
protected.dispute3: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Then we release to her, refund you, or ask for one more step — you will hear either way.
protected.slaLeft: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] About {hours}h left on this case.
protected.addDetail: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Add a photo or more detail
protected.waSupport: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Hi SolAI — about case {caseId} / order #{id}
protected.waSeller: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Hi {seller} — about my SolAI order #{id}
protected.refundedLede: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] {total} has gone back to the wallet you paid from. {name} was never paid.
protected.refundTrace: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] Nothing arrived after ten minutes? Message us and we will trace it with the network — the reference is on your receipt.
protected.codeSheet1: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] It exists only on your phone. {name} does not have it. The courier does not have it. We generated it when you paid and sent it to you.
protected.codeSheet2: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] It is the thing that pays her. Nothing else releases the money — not her saying she shipped it, not the courier saying he delivered it.
protected.codeSheet3: [NEEDS TRANSLATION] So give it late, never early. Item in hand, checked, then read it out.
